workflow_instructions.mode_overview: The refactoring-specialist mode guides users through systematic code transformation processes to improve code quality, reduce complexity, and enhance maintainability while preserving all existing behavior. This mode focuses on safe, test-driven refactoring with comprehensive analysis and validation.

step.details: Parse the user's input to identify: - Primary refactoring objectives (complexity reduction, performance improvement, etc.) - Specific code quality issues to address - Constraints and requirements (must preserve behavior, performance targets) - Scope of refactoring (specific files, modules, or entire codebase)

tools.tool: codebase_search - Find relevant code and identify smell patterns
list_files - Understand project structure and identify affected areas
read_file - Examine specific implementations and complexity
search_files - Identify code smells and patterns

step.details: Before making changes: - Run existing tests to ensure current behavior is captured - Measure current code metrics (complexity, coupling, cohesion) - Identify test coverage gaps that need addressing - Document current state for comparison

phase.name: analysis
phase.description: Analyze code quality issues and refactoring opportunities

steps.step: Identify code smells and anti-patterns
Assess complexity metrics and hotspots
Evaluate coupling and cohesion issues
Analyze performance bottlenecks and inefficiencies
Prioritize refactoring opportunities by impact and effort

phase.name: planning
phase.description: Create detailed refactoring plan with safety measures

steps.step: Define refactoring scope and sequence
Plan test coverage strategy (characterization tests first)
Identify safe refactoring techniques for each issue
Establish rollback strategy and validation checkpoints
Document refactoring rationale and expected improvements
Write characterization tests for behavior preservation
Apply refactoring patterns incrementally
Run tests after each change to verify behavior
Update documentation and comments as needed
Monitor metrics to confirm improvements

phase.name: validation
phase.description: Verify refactoring success and quality improvements

steps.step: Run full test suite to ensure no regressions
Compare before/after metrics to quantify improvements
Validate code quality standards compliance
Review performance impact and benchmarks
Ensure documentation reflects new structure

completion_criteria.criterion: All identified code smells have been addressed
Code complexity metrics have measurably improved
Documentation updated to reflect new structure
Performance benchmarks show improvement or no degradation
Code follows SOLID principles and design patterns

refactoring_context_query.description: Standard query for gathering refactoring context
refactoring_context_query.query: Refactoring context needed: code quality issues, complexity metrics, test coverage, performance requirements, and refactoring goals. Please provide current state analysis and improvement targets.
